claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant (ClassFeature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spellcasting is not activated — it permanently grants a spell slot pool and spell list access with no activation cost, no use-count, and no explicit reset cadence tied to the feature itself. The existing activation family mandates activationCost + UseCountResource + resetCadence, none of which model a spellcasting framework feature. A new family (e.g. passive_grant or spellcasting_framework) is needed for class features that are always-on grants of resources and access.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Drawing from your innate magic, you can cast spells. [...] You know four Sorcerer cantrips of your choice. [...] The Sorcerer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy lists grant_spell_access as an effect atom, but it does not appear in the ClassFeatureEffect union type (which only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect). Spellcasting grants cantrip and prepared-spell list access scaling by class level — this needs a ClassFeatureEffect variant that models the list source (class spell list), the initial known/prepared count, and the scaling schedule (threshold_tiers or linear_per_level with axis=class).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know four Sorcerer cantrips of your choice. [...] choose two level 1 Sorcerer spells. [...] The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Sorcerer levels.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_slot_pool (ClassFeatureEffect variant or resource shape)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell_slot resource atom exists in v4, but there is no surface type that models a class feature granting a full leveled slot table (e.g. 2 L1 slots at sorcerer L1, growing per class progression). This is distinct from a simple use_count: slots are differentiated by level, upcast constraints apply, and the reset is long-rest only. A new ClassFeatureEffect or resource shape is needed to express: class, axis=class, slot levels and counts per class level, resetCadence=long_rest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Sorcerer Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_spellcasting_ability (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Charisma is designated as the spellcasting ability, which determines spell attack rolls and save DCs for all sorcerer spells. This is a deterministic, class-feature-granted runtime fact (not DM adjudication), but it maps to no existing ClassFeatureEffect variant. It could be modeled as a modify_roll_substitute-like designation or a dedicated set_spellcasting_ability variant. Per ARCHITECTURE.md this may ultimately be pre-runtime character state, but at minimum the surface needs a way to record the designation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your Sorcerer spells.
